column2: Physical Moves are resisted with Defense. They are close range attacks by default. Some can be long range, and those are labeled as Ranged.
Special Moves are resisted with Special Defense. They are always long range.
Support Moves don't deal any direct Damage.
Reduce the noted number of successes from the Move's Accuracy Roll.
Heal for 3HP.
This Move has the Bite Move keyword and interacts with Abilities, Items, and effects that reference Bite Moves.
The Target can't escape and can't be switched back.

The probability at which a Move's Effect is activated. The number marked on the Icon is the amount of Chance Dice you will Roll. At least one Chance Dice must come up as (6), if it does, the Effect will be triggered. Sometimes a Chance Dice Icon will be inside a Status Ailment Box to show the chance to inflict that Ailment.
The User spends one action charging the Move. The Move is rolled with another action on its next turn.
Copies or reproduces another Move as described by its effect. Unique Moves cannot be copied unless specifically stated otherwise.
This Move has the Cutter Move keyword and interacts with Abilities, Items, and effects that reference Cutter Moves.
The Move strikes or resolves twice as part of the same Action.
Places a persistent hazard on a side of the Battlefield as described by the Move.
The Move requires hands or fists.
Creates a defensive field that remains active for the stated Duration or until removed.
Score a Critical Hit with 1 success less than required.
Ignore Defense and Special Defense when calculating Damage.
The Move may be used as a Late Reaction. The listed number determines its Reaction timing.
The Move inflicts Lethal Damage.
After hitting with this Move, the User must rest with its first Action on the next Round.
This Move cannot be Evaded, but can be Clashed. This Move may still miss on a failed Accuracy check.

At the end of the Round, Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against the Target. (Multiple sources of Ongoing Damage will not stack, only one source may be active at a time. The first source takes priority over the latter ones).
While charging, the User is Out of Range except to Moves specifically stated to be able to hit it.
This Move has the Powder Move keyword and interacts with effects that reference Powder Moves.
This Move has the Projectile Move keyword and interacts with effects that reference Projectile Moves.
The User may use this Move up to 3 times without interruption, even during the same Round. It cannot Evade or perform another Move. After the Rampage is over, the user will be Confused.
This Move may be used at range.
The Move may be used as a Reaction. The listed number determines its Reaction timing.
The User will be hurt by its own Move. Roll damage normally against the foe, then roll again each success you scored as damage to the User ignoring its defenses.
If the Pokémon performs another Shield Move during the next Round, that Move's Accuracy Roll is reduced by 2 successes.
These Moves bypass Substitute, Light Screen, Reflect, and Cover.
The Move allows you to perform Multiple Actions in succession before the Foe can act. (Up to either 2 attacks or 5 attacks based on the number of stars in the Effect box).
Only one Switcher Move may be used per Round. Switch a Pokémon in the battlefield for one of its allies still on their Pokeball.
Unique Moves cannot be copied.
This Move has the Wind Move keyword and interacts with Abilities, Items, and effects that reference Wind Moves.
